features.name: reserve_actor
features.formula: state.reserve[state.player]

features.name: reserve_opponent
features.formula: state.reserve[1-state.player]

features.name: pending_actor
features.formula: state.pending[state.player]

features.name: pending_opponent
features.formula: state.pending[1-state.player]

features.name: house_owned_actor
features.formula: state.houseOwned[state.player] ? 1 : 0

features.name: house_owned_opponent
features.formula: state.houseOwned[1-state.player] ? 1 : 0

features.name: pit_seed_total_actor
features.formula: sum of all 16 pits for actor

features.name: pit_seed_total_opponent
features.formula: sum of all 16 pits for opponent

features.name: occupied_pits_actor
features.formula: count actor pits with seeds > 0

features.name: occupied_pits_opponent
features.formula: count opponent pits with seeds > 0

features.name: max_pit_actor
features.formula: maximum actor pit seed count

features.name: max_pit_opponent
features.formula: maximum opponent pit seed count

features.name: legal_move_count
features.formula: count exact legal move variants at root

features.name: capture_move_fraction
features.formula: capture legal moves / legal_move_count

features.name: takata_move_fraction
features.formula: takata legal moves / legal_move_count

features.name: move_type_entropy
features.formula: Shannon entropy base2 over exact legal move type counts in lexical type order

features.name: successor_reply_width_min
features.formula: minimum exact opponent legal reply count across all legal root moves; terminal successor contributes 0

features.name: successor_reply_width_median
features.formula: median exact opponent legal reply count across all legal root moves; even-N median is arithmetic mean of middle two

features.name: successor_reply_width_max
features.formula: maximum exact opponent legal reply count across all legal root moves; terminal successor contributes 0

features.name: successor_reply_width_range
features.formula: successor_reply_width_max - successor_reply_width_min

features.name: d1_d2_best_move_same
features.formula: 1 iff canonical best move key under D1_Q1 equals canonical best move key under D2_Q1, else 0

features.name: d1_d2_topset_jaccard
features.formula: Jaccard similarity of exact maximum-score move-key sets under D1_Q1 and D2_Q1

features.name: d1_d2_abs_best_score_delta
features.formula: abs(D2_Q1 bestScore - D1_Q1 bestScore)

features.name: d2_best_reply_count
features.formula: exact legal opponent reply count after D2_Q1 canonical best root move; terminal successor => 0

features.name: d2_best_reply_nonterminal_fraction
features.formula: fraction of exact opponent replies whose resulting state is nonterminal; no replies => 0

features.name: d2_best_reply_static_score_range
features.formula: max minus min bao static evaluator score from original root actor perspective across reply-result states; fewer than 2 replies => 0

features.name: c03_original_scope_applicable
features.formula: 1 iff root is eligible under immutable TM-S2-C03 original frozen scope, else 0

features.name: c03_original_scope_success
features.formula: TM-S2-C03 structural success iff F27=1; encode 0 when F27=0

scalingContract.center: featurewise median over selected Stage 1 roots
scalingContract.scale: featurewise median absolute deviation from frozen median
scalingContract.zeroMadTransform: all transformed values for that feature are 0; feature is retained, not deleted
